description: changelog prints the export target the build embedded and exits 0 with stderr empty, or, in a binary built without relmap, fails closed with KDLITH-CHG001 (exit 1, stdout empty) on every target. No generate step runs (the entrypoint and crate keys the kind requires go unused); the one exercise step runs check.sh in the scratch copy, which judges the build path the run declares: KDLITH_FX_CHANGELOG=absent for a binary built without relmap, anything else for one built with it. With relmap the default and --target markdown both open with the Changelog title followed by a release heading and carry the 0.1.0 release's heading and summary exactly; ndjson is one compact record per line under a header record, and index and metadata are pretty-printed JSON, one value per line. The remaining bytes are relmap's rendering of the changelog records and are not pinned here; an unknown target is an argument fault (exit 2) on both paths
